ashweather_cycle_preset.title: Cycle Weather Preset
ashweather_cycle_preset.desc: Moves to the next weather preset for the current map profile set

ashweather_toggle_system.title: Toggle Weather System
ashweather_toggle_system.desc: Enables or disables Dynamic Weather Survival

ashweather_activate_system.onDown: if ashWeatherMain then ashWeatherMain.activateWeather('hotkey activate') end
ashweather_activate_system.title: Activate Dynamic Weather
ashweather_activate_system.desc: Starts Dynamic Weather Survival if it is currently inactive

ashweather_deactivate_system.onDown: if ashWeatherMain then ashWeatherMain.deactivateWeather('hotkey deactivate') end
ashweather_deactivate_system.title: Deactivate Dynamic Weather
ashweather_deactivate_system.desc: Stops Dynamic Weather Survival and saves the current session state

ashweather_toggle_auto_cycle.title: Toggle Dynamic Weather
ashweather_toggle_auto_cycle.desc: Turns scheduled dynamic weather transitions on or off

ashweather_reset_environment.title: Reset Weather Environment
ashweather_reset_environment.desc: Resets the environment and hides mapped rain objects

ashweather_random_weather.title: Trigger Random Weather
ashweather_random_weather.desc: Selects a weighted random weather event for the current map

ashweather_trigger_lightning.title: Trigger Lightning Hook
ashweather_trigger_lightning.desc: Fires the Dynamic Weather Survival lightning hook for compatible effects

ashweather_trigger_lightning_strikes.title: Trigger Lightning Strikes
ashweather_trigger_lightning_strikes.desc: Starts a short lightning strike sequence
